title: data/public/regions.json
description: Every region. The list is open: adding a region needs only data files, never app code.

parent.description: Parent region id (antarctica for its sub-regions), or null.

kind.description: What the region is, for grouping in the picker. global means no outline geometry. coastal_sea is a sea area whose mean sea level is reported. country is a land area inside a national border (added 2026-11-13, Bangladesh).

variables.description: Variables valid here. Must be the inverse of variables.json regions.

notes.description: Optional caveats shown only when this region is selected (added 2026-11-12).

camera.description: Preset for camera.flyTo. Height in metres, angles in degrees.
